market_question: Will Ivan Cepeda Castro win the 2026 Colombian presidential election?
reasoning: Cepeda is a left-wing senator but not the frontrunner for 2026. The left is fragmented without Petro and polls point to stronger center-right candidates. His true chances appear low, so the market overestimates his odds.
evidence_points: Left-wing coalition is divided with multiple possible candidates (Márquez, Bolívar, etc.) and no clear consensus.
Early pre-2025 polls show candidates like Vicky Dávila and Federico Gutiérrez leading, with left candidates collectively polling well below 41%.
Cepeda’s name recognition is moderate, and he lacks the cross-party appeal or momentum of the leading contenders.
